newsitem.title: USA: Orckit signs agreement with Harris.
newsitem.headline: Orckit signs agreement with Harris.

text.p: Orckit Communications Ltd said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement with Harris Corp unit Harris Semiconductor to develop a new advanced VDSL chipset.
The company said the chipset, called HC6100, will enable widespread deployment of integrated VDSL modems in 1998. It expects chipset samples to be available by the second quarter of 1998.
The company said they will be priced to allow equipment vendors to offer their telecom operator customers VDSL modems at $500 per line, in volume installations.
The company did not provide information on projected revenues from the agreement.

VDSL, which stands for very high bit rate digital subscriber line, is a technology that allows high-speed data transmission over a regular copper telephone wire, and supports applications such as high definition television, interactive multimedia, and Internet access.
